versos.hebraico: לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ׀ לְעֶ֥בֶד יְהוָ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּ֨ר׀ לַיהוָ֗ה אֶת־דִּ֭בְרֵי הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּי֤וֹם הִֽצִּיל־יְהוָ֘ה אוֹת֥וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל־אֹ֝יְבָ֗יו וּמִיַּ֥ד שָׁאֽוּל׃
וַיֹּאמַ֡ר אֶרְחָמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חִזְקִֽי׃

controles.web: I love you, Yahweh, my strength.
controles.kjv: I will love thee, O Lord, my strength.
controles.livre: Eu te amarei, SENHOR, tu és minha força.

versos.hebraico: יְהוָ֤ה׀ סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִ֗י וּמְפַ֫לְטִ֥י אֵלִ֣י צ֭וּרִי אֶֽחֱסֶה־בּ֑וֹ מָֽגִנִּ֥י וְקֶֽרֶן־יִ֝שְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי׃

controles.web: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
controles.kjv: The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
controles.livre: O SENHOR é minha rocha, e minha fortaleza, e meu libertador, meu Deus, meu rochedo, em quem confio; é meu escudo, e a força da minha salvação, meu alto refúgio.

versos.hebraico: מְ֭הֻלָּל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּמִן־אֹ֝יְבַ֗י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃

controles.web: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.
controles.kjv: I will call upon the Lord, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
controles.livre: Eu clamei ao SENHOR digno de louvor; e fiquei livre de meus inimigos.

versos.hebraico: אֲפָפ֥וּנִי חֶבְלֵי־מָ֑וֶת וְֽנַחֲלֵ֖י בְלִיַּ֣עַל יְבַֽעֲתֽוּנִי׃

controles.web: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
controles.kjv: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
controles.livre: Cordas de morte me cercaram; e riachos de maldade me encheram de medo.

versos.hebraico: חֶבְלֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל סְבָב֑וּנִי קִ֝דְּמ֗וּנִי מ֣וֹקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃

controles.web: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.
controles.kjv: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.
controles.livre: Cordas do mundo dos mortos me envolveram; laços de morte me confrontaram.

versos.hebraico: בַּצַּר־לִ֤י׀ אֶֽקְרָ֣א יְהוָה֮ וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַ֪י אֲשַׁ֫וֵּ֥עַ יִשְׁמַ֣ע מֵהֵיכָל֣וֹ קוֹלִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֤יו׀ תָּב֬וֹא בְאָזְנָֽיו׃

controles.web: In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.
controles.kjv: In my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.
controles.livre: Em minha angústia, clamei ao SENHOR, e roguei a meu Deus; desde o seu Templo ele ouviu a minha voz; e o meu clamor diante de seu rosto chegou aos ouvidos dele.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּגְעַ֬שׁ וַתִּרְעַ֨שׁ׀ הָאָ֗רֶץ וּמוֹסְדֵ֣י הָרִ֣ים יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַ֝יִּתְגָּֽעֲשׁ֗וּ כִּי־חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
controles.kjv: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
controles.livre: Então a terra de abalou e tremeu; e os fundamentos dos montes de moveram e foram abalados, porque ele se irritou.

versos.hebraico: עָ֘לָ֤ה עָשָׁ֨ן׀ בְּאַפּ֗וֹ וְאֵשׁ־מִפִּ֥יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּ֝חָלִ֗ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
controles.kjv: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
controles.livre: Fumaça subiu de seu nariz, e fogo consumidor saiu de sua boca; carvões foram acesos por ele.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֣ט שָׁ֭מַיִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽיו׃

controles.web: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
controles.kjv: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.
controles.livre: Ele moveu os céus, e desceu; e as trevas estavam debaixo de seus pés.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּרְכַּ֣ב עַל־כְּ֭רוּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַ֝יֵּ֗דֶא עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רֽוּחַ׃

controles.web: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
controles.kjv: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
controles.livre: Ele montou sobre um querubim, e fez seu voo; e voou veloz sobre as assas do vento.

versos.hebraico: יָ֤שֶׁת חֹ֨שֶׁךְ׀ סִתְר֗וֹ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֥יו סֻכָּת֑וֹ חֶשְׁכַת־מַ֝֗יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים׃

controles.web: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
controles.kjv: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
controles.livre: Ele pôs as trevas como seu esconderijo; pôs a sua tenda ao redor dele; trevas das águas, nuvens dos céus.

versos.hebraico: מִנֹּ֗גַהּ נֶ֫גְדּ֥וֹ עָבָ֥יו עָבְר֑וּ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי־אֵֽשׁ׃

controles.web: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.
controles.kjv: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.
controles.livre: Do brilho de sua presença suas nuvens se espalharam, e também a saraiva, e as brasas de fogo.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּרְעֵ֬ם בַּשָּׁמַ֨יִם׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה וְ֭עֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן קֹל֑וֹ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי־אֵֽשׁ׃

controles.web: Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.
controles.kjv: The Lord also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR trovejou nos céus; e o Altíssimo soltou sua voz; saraiva e brasas de fogo caíram .

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח חִ֭צָּיו וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם וּבְרָקִ֥ים רָ֝ב וַיְהֻמֵּֽם׃

controles.web: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them; Yes, great lightning bolts, and routed them.
controles.kjv: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
controles.livre: Ele mandou suas flechas, e os dispersou; e lançou muitos raios, e os perturbou.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֤רָא֨וּ׀ אֲפִ֥יקֵי מַ֗יִם וַֽיִּגָּלוּ֮ מוֹסְד֪וֹת תֵּ֫בֵ֥ל מִגַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝נִּשְׁמַ֗ת ר֣וּחַ אַפֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
controles.kjv: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O Lord, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
controles.livre: E as profundezas das águas foram vistas, e os fundamentos do mundo foram descobertos por tua repreensão, SENHOR, pelo sopro do vento do teu nariz.

versos.hebraico: יִשְׁלַ֣ח מִ֭מָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽ֝מְשֵׁ֗נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃

controles.web: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
controles.kjv: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.
controles.livre: Desde o alto ele enviou, e me tomou; tirou-me de muitas águas.

versos.hebraico: יַצִּילֵ֗נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֥י עָ֑ז וּ֝מִשֹּׂנְאַ֗י כִּֽי־אָמְצ֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

controles.web: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
controles.kjv: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
controles.livre: Ele me livrou do meu forte inimigo, e daqueles que me odeiam; porque eles eram mais poderosos do que eu.

versos.hebraico: יְקַדְּמ֥וּנִי בְיוֹם־אֵידִ֑י וַֽיְהִי־יְהוָ֖ה לְמִשְׁעָ֣ן לִֽי׃

controles.web: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.
controles.kjv: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay.
controles.livre: Eles me confrontaram no dia de minha calamidade; mas o SENHOR ficou junto de mim.

versos.hebraico: וַיּוֹצִיאֵ֥נִי לַמֶּרְחָ֑ב יְ֝חַלְּצֵ֗נִי כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי׃

controles.web: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
controles.kjv: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
controles.livre: Ele me tirou para um lugar amplo; ele me libertou, porque se agradou de mim.

versos.hebraico: יִגְמְלֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה כְּצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי׃

controles.web: Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands has he recompensed me.
controles.kjv: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
controles.livre: O SENHOR me recompensou conforme a minha justiça; conforme a pureza das minhas mãos ele me retribuiu.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־שָׁ֭מַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־רָ֝שַׁ֗עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי׃

controles.web: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
controles.kjv: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
controles.livre: Porque eu guardei os caminhos do SENHOR; nem me afastei do meu Deus praticando o mal.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י כָל־מִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְ֝חֻקֹּתָ֗יו לֹא־אָסִ֥יר מֶֽנִּי׃

controles.web: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.
controles.kjv: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
controles.livre: Porque todos os juízos dele estavam diante de mim; e não rejeitei seus estatutos para mim.

versos.hebraico: וָאֱהִ֣י תָמִ֣ים עִמּ֑וֹ וָ֝אֶשְׁתַּמֵּ֗ר מֵעֲוֺנִֽי׃

controles.web: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
controles.kjv: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
controles.livre: Mas eu fui fiel com ele; e tomei cuidado contra minha maldade.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּֽשֶׁב־יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣י כְצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃

controles.web: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
controles.kjv: Therefore hath the Lord recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
controles.livre: Assim o SENHOR me recompensou conforme a minha justiça; conforme a pureza de minhas mãos perante seus olhos.

versos.hebraico: עִם־חָסִ֥יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם־גְּבַ֥ר תָּ֝מִ֗ים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃

controles.web: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.
controles.kjv: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
controles.livre: Com o bondoso tu te mostras bondoso; e com o homem fiel tu te mostras fiel.

versos.hebraico: עִם־נָבָ֥ר תִּתְבָּרָ֑ר וְעִם־עִ֝קֵּ֗שׁ תִּתְפַּתָּֽל׃

controles.web: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
controles.kjv: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
controles.livre: Com o puro tu te mostras puro; mas com o perverso tu te mostras agressivo.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה עַם־עָנִ֣י תוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינַ֖יִם רָמ֣וֹת תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃

controles.web: For you will save the afflicted people, but the haughty eyes you will bring down.
controles.kjv: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
controles.livre: Porque tu livras ao povo aflito, e humilhas aos olhos que se exaltam.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה תָּאִ֣יר נֵרִ֑י יְהוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי׃

controles.web: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.
controles.kjv: For thou wilt light my candle: the Lord my God will enlighten my darkness.
controles.livre: Porque tu acendes minha lâmpada; o SENHOR meu Deus ilumina as minhas trevas.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־בְ֭ךָ אָרֻ֣ץ גְּד֑וּד וּ֝בֵֽאלֹהַ֗י אֲדַלֶּג־שֽׁוּר׃

controles.web: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
controles.kjv: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
controles.livre: Porque contigo eu marcho contra um exército; e com meu Deus eu salto um muro.

versos.hebraico: הָאֵל֮ תָּמִ֪ים דַּ֫רְכּ֥וֹ אִמְרַֽת־יְהוָ֥ה צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לְכֹ֤ל׀ הַחֹסִ֬ים בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
controles.kjv: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
controles.livre: O caminho de Deus é perfeito; a palavra do SENHOR é refinada; ele é escudo para todos os que nele confiam.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י מִ֣י אֱ֭לוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֝֗וּר זוּלָתִ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

controles.web: For who is God, except Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God,
controles.kjv: For who is God save the Lord? or who is a rock save our God?
controles.livre: Porque quem é Deus, a não ser o SENHOR? E quem é rocha, a não ser o nosso Deus?

versos.hebraico: הָ֭אֵל הַמְאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חָ֑יִל וַיִּתֵּ֖ן תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכִּֽי׃

controles.web: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
controles.kjv: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
controles.livre: Deus é o que me veste de força; e o que dá perfeição ao meu caminho.

versos.hebraico: מְשַׁוֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַי כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּ֝מֹתַ֗י יַעֲמִידֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.
controles.kjv: He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet, and setteth me upon my high places.
controles.livre: Ele faz meus pés como o das cervas; e me põe em meus lugares altos.

versos.hebraico: מְלַמֵּ֣ד יָ֭דַי לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְֽנִחֲתָ֥ה קֶֽשֶׁת־נְ֝חוּשָׁ֗ה זְרוֹעֹתָֽי׃

controles.web: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
controles.kjv: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
controles.livre: Ele ensina minhas mãos para a guerra, de modo que um arco de bronze se quebra em meus braços.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּתֶּן־לִי֮ מָגֵ֪ן יִ֫שְׁעֶ֥ךָ וִֽימִינְךָ֥ תִסְעָדֵ֑נִי וְֽעַנְוַתְךָ֥ תַרְבֵּֽנִי׃

controles.web: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.
controles.kjv: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.
controles.livre: Também tu me deste o escudo de tua salvação, e tua mão direita me sustentou; e tua mansidão me engrandeceu.

versos.hebraico: תַּרְחִ֣יב צַעֲדִ֣י תַחְתָּ֑י וְלֹ֥א מָ֝עֲד֗וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃

controles.web: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
controles.kjv: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
controles.livre: Tu alargaste os meus passos abaixo de mim; e meus pés não vacilaram.

versos.hebraico: אֶרְדּ֣וֹף א֭וֹיְבַי וְאַשִּׂיגֵ֑ם וְלֹֽא־אָ֝שׁוּב עַד־כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. Neither will I turn again until they are consumed.
controles.kjv: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
controles.livre: Persegui a meus inimigos, e eu os alcancei; e não voltei até os exterminá-los.

versos.hebraico: אֶ֭מְחָצֵם וְלֹא־יֻ֣כְלוּ ק֑וּם יִ֝פְּל֗וּ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽי׃

controles.web: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.
controles.kjv: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
controles.livre: Eu os perfurei, que não puderam mais se levantar; caíram debaixo dos meus pés.

versos.hebraico: וַתְּאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חַ֭יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֖יעַ קָמַ֣י תַּחְתָּֽי׃

controles.web: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
controles.kjv: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
controles.livre: Porque tu me preparaste com força para a batalha; fizeste se curvarem abaixo de mim aqueles que contra mim tinham se levantado.

versos.hebraico: וְֽאֹיְבַ֗י נָתַ֣תָּה לִּ֣י עֹ֑רֶף וּ֝מְשַׂנְאַ֗י אַצְמִיתֵֽם׃

controles.web: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
controles.kjv: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
controles.livre: E tu me deste a nuca de meus inimigos; destruí aos que me odiavam.

versos.hebraico: יְשַׁוְּע֥וּ וְאֵין־מוֹשִׁ֑יעַ עַל־יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְלֹ֣א עָנָֽם׃

controles.web: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.
controles.kjv: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the Lord, but he answered them not.
controles.livre: Eles clamaram, mas não havia quem os livrasse; clamaram até ao SENHOR, mas ele não lhes respondeu.

versos.hebraico: וְֽאֶשְׁחָקֵ֗ם כְּעָפָ֥ר עַל־פְּנֵי־ר֑וּחַ כְּטִ֖יט חוּצ֣וֹת אֲרִיקֵֽם׃

controles.web: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.
controles.kjv: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
controles.livre: Então eu os reduzi a pó, como a poeira ao vento; eu os joguei fora como a lama das ruas.

versos.hebraico: תְּפַלְּטֵנִי֮ מֵרִ֪יבֵ֫י עָ֥ם תְּ֭שִׂימֵנִי לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֑ם עַ֖ם לֹא־יָדַ֣עְתִּי יַֽעַבְדֽוּנִי׃

controles.web: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
controles.kjv: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
controles.livre: Tu me livraste das brigas do povo; tu me puseste como cabeça das nações; o povo que eu não conhecia me serviu.

versos.hebraico: לְשֵׁ֣מַֽע אֹ֭זֶן יִשָּׁ֣מְעוּ לִ֑י בְּנֵֽי־נֵ֝כָ֗ר יְכַחֲשׁוּ־לִֽי׃

controles.web: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.
controles.kjv: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
controles.livre: Ao me ouvirem, logo me obedeceram; estrangeiros se sujeitaram a mim.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־נֵכָ֥ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְ֝יַחְרְג֗וּ מִֽמִּסְגְּרֽוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their close places.
controles.kjv: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
controles.livre: Estrangeiros se enfraqueceram; e tremeram de medo desde suas extremidades.

versos.hebraico: חַי־יְ֭הוָה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְ֝יָר֗וּם אֱלוֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃

controles.web: Yahweh lives; and blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,
controles.kjv: The Lord liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
controles.livre: O SENHOR vive, e bendito seja minha rocha; e exaltado seja o Deus de minha salvação;

versos.hebraico: הָאֵ֗ל הַנּוֹתֵ֣ן נְקָמ֣וֹת לִ֑י וַיַּדְבֵּ֖ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽי׃

controles.web: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.
controles.kjv: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.
controles.livre: O Deus que dá minha vingança, e sujeita aos povos debaixo de mim;

versos.hebraico: מְפַלְּטִ֗י מֵאֹ֫יְבָ֥י אַ֣ף מִן־קָ֭מַי תְּרוֹמְמֵ֑נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חָ֝מָ֗ס תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
controles.kjv: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
controles.livre: Aquele que me livra dos meus inimigos; tu também me exaltas sobre aqueles que se levantam contra mim; tu me livras do homem violento.

versos.hebraico: עַל־כֵּ֤ן׀ אוֹדְךָ֖ בַגּוֹיִ֥ם׀ יְהוָ֑ה וּלְשִׁמְךָ֥ אֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃

controles.web: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
controles.kjv: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.
controles.livre: Por isso, SENHOR, eu te louvarei entre as nações, e cantarei ao teu Nome;

versos.hebraico: מגדל יְשׁוּע֪וֹת מַ֫לְכּ֥וֹ וְעֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֨סֶד׀ לִמְשִׁיח֗וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֗וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his seed, forever more.
controles.kjv: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
controles.livre: Que faz grandes as salvações de seu Rei, e pratica a bondade para com o seu ungido, com Davi, e sua semente, para sempre.
